scenario: Web project migration and .lumina archive import reject corrupt state without replacing the current project.
input: A legacy IndexedDB project record, an unsupported schema, or a .lumina archive with a corrupt checksum or manifest revision.
visibleError: The importer returns checksum_mismatch or invalid_manifest; an unsupported project opens in read-only recovery mode.
recovery: The corrupted archive is rejected before import commits, and migration failures keep the original record recoverable and read-only.
sideEffects: No replacement project or asset records are committed from the corrupt input; recovery projects can still be deleted deliberately.
